QuakeWorld 4on4 TDM

== History ==
Originally started with under the name of Team47, c47 was one of the teams back in the days who had quite often an opportunity to play 
from the same location which allowed to use MM3 and very low ping. Team heavily hailed from the city of Pori, Finland.
Later after the team was shut down, few players joined up with the legendary clan Cute.
